note: How a cursor or a finger behaves in a UI demo, so it reads as a person, not a tween. Times in ms, distances in px at 1080p. Numbers from Stageshow 1.1.0 (github.com/benjitaylor/skills, ccb6a38, MIT, kit/act.ts and cursor.css, plus the 71 example scenes); the curves are mapped to our tokens. Used by the cursor kit piece (tools/ss_elements.jsx) and the code templates that show a UI.

move.why: longer trips take longer but never drag; a slight arc, never a ruler line

aim.why: land inside the target, off its label, so the cursor never covers the word it clicks

drag.drop_slot: jumps cell to cell and fades (120 ms); it never travels

typing.caret: solid while typing, blinks every ~1.05 s at rest
typing.overwrite: show select-all before typing over a value
typing.why: 35 ms is only a kit default; the scenes type slower and unevenly, by context

result.why: a clicked state answers at once; the result then holds while the shot keeps drifting

extras.kind_changes: I-beam over text, hand over links, grab while dragging
